stem: One identified cultivar roots more slowly than the others under the supplied procedure. What should Technician I do?
choices: Increase treatment concentration for every tray
Record the batch-specific rooting trend and escalate if outside the defined expectation rather than independently redesigning propagation conditions
Assume the donor genotype is defective
